name: Communication Diagram
description: Communication Diagram describes participating objects, links between them, and numbered messages. This diagram emphasizes the network of object links rather than a visual time axis.
purpose: Analyze which objects know/call which other objects within an interaction network.
bestFor: Analyze code change impact: which objects connect to which
Design communication networks between objects in distributed systems
Describe interactions when timing does not need to be explicit
Clarify which objects know/call which other objects
notSuitableFor: Need explicit time-order visualization → use Sequence Diagram
Describe business workflow with swimlanes → use Activity Diagram
Describe static class structure → use Class Diagram
useCases: Draw links between objects that communicate directly

elements.name: Object
elements.description: Object/component participating in interaction: cart: Cart, orderSvc: OrderService

confusableWith.difference: Communication uses object network layout and numbered messages; Sequence uses lifelines and a time axis.
Object diagram only describes static objects and data links; Communication has interactive messages.
